subject: SAME AS clause
notes: kb/Work PB1302 (wave 1019 D). SR3 is ONE order-independent test: the expansion chain carries every subject in progress, and a data-name-1 that IS or CONTAINS one of them holds a SAME AS reaching the subject (COBOL1557); the target's subtree is completed on the same chain before it is copied, so `01 G. 05 X PIC X. 05 Y SAME AS H. 01 H SAME AS G.` is 1557 whichever entry expands first (it drew only a cascade COBOL0881 before). A TYPE clause in that subtree naming a declaration in progress is 13.18.57.3 SR1 (l1c27 / l1c34 negatives keep their 1557).
